topic: Someone receives flowers with no card attached
text: I returned to the den, the earth still damp from the morning's rain. The air, thick with the scent of pine and the earthy musk of soil, seemed to hold a whisper of something out of place. Outside, the usual sounds of the forest carried on, but there was a hush that settled over me, a weight I couldn't shake. The flowers, vibrant and unfamiliar, lay untouched where I had placed them. I knew the reason for their arrival, yet I avoided the eyes of the others, my movements cautious, as if treading on fragile ground. Each step felt heavier, the silence around me more profound. I couldn’t help but think of the trail I left, the scent lingering in the air, a constant reminder of what I had done.
